title: College Football Week Ahead
subject: CFB Week 4: Illinois–Ohio State leads 10 games worth researching
preview_text: Widest gap to a book number: 6.3 points on Vanderbilt at Auburn. 10 of 10 featured games carry a book number. Research, not picks.

paragraphs: EdgeDesk scored 71 upcoming college football games for Week 4 and put 10 in front of you.
The widest disagreement with a book number is 6.3 points. 10 of the 10 featured games carry a joined sportsbook number; the rest are model-only reads.

13 games with a larger gap were left out on purpose: the discrepancy was bigger than the evidence behind it. A big number on thin data is the most common way research goes wrong, and leaving it out is the finding.

difference.text: Both numbers above are quoted from Ohio State’s side, and EdgeDesk’s sits 5.9 points toward Illinois of the market’s.

why.text: On EdgeDesk’s own ETSR (overall) scale it has Ohio State #2 of 133 at +11.6 and Illinois #42 of 133 at +2.7.

why.source: matchups.Ohio State pass offense vs Illinois pass defense
why.text: Ohio State’s pass offense rates 64.0 (#7 of 132) against Illinois’s pass defense at 40.8 (#116 of 133). Ohio State’s unit stands higher among its own position group, by 109 places.
Ohio State carries the wider measured edge on Pass defense — 58.5 · #24 of 133 against Illinois’ 40.8 · #116 of 133.
